reason: Conservative default: lowest measured HTTP P95/P99, higher window order TPS, shorter batch tail than57;57 improves bridge but downstream sender remains limiting

config.warmupSettlementPoll: Each worker, 1 second interval, 60 second bound, outside formal; same HTTP POST sampler/thread
config.finalResultPolling: After formal HTTP only; fair round-robin, concurrency16, max100 calls/batch, >=1s between batches, global120s deadline. Per-request interval grows with outstanding set. No per-request starvation; actual attempt timestamps archived.
config.pacer: One serialized coordinator; Windows park leaves 16ms headroom then spins; at400/s may use one CPU core, captured in host load, never subtracted
config.serverJfr: Only custom sale events + GC pause + DataLoss, no stacks/environment/JVM properties

summary.drainObservationNote: Confirmation upper bound includes post-load polling and reconciliation, not exact queue empty instant; use observations for tighter bracket.

batch.allBridgeSqlScope: Includes prepare/scans including empty scans and quarantine; statement start in window. Batch commits use return in window. No per-request autocommit SELECT transaction counts inferred.

supplemental.lockDurationCaveat: Return-to-commit is a lower bound on lock holding; SQL lockCampaign includes query/RTT as well as possible lock wait.
